properties.body:
👋 Thanks for your message.

This number only runs a short survey during the session, so there is nothing further needed from you here.

If you have a question, the IPA team at the training can help.

Thinking about the training week as a whole, that is the period running from Sunday the 23rd of August to Friday the 28th of August inclusive, and taking into consideration all of its components together - the plenary sessions, the practical exercises, the group work and the informal exchanges between them - which single day of that week would you say is, or you expect will be, the most rewarding for you personally?

[INTERVIEWER: Read out the days one at a time. Record one day only. If the respondent names more than one, probe for the single most rewarding.]

_Reply with the day._

During the midday meal break held earlier today, Wednesday the 26th of August, immediately preceding the present session, did the meal that you yourself consumed include a dessert - understood as any sweet course, confection, pastry, fruit preparation or other sweet item - whether taken as part of that meal or immediately following it?

[INTERVIEWER: Do not read the response options. Code 'yes' if the respondent reports any sweet item, however small.]

_Reply yes or no._

Considering the whole of yesterday, Tuesday the 25th of August, from the time you woke until the time you retired for the night, and counting each serving separately irrespective of its size, its preparation or where it was obtained, how many servings of coffee or tea did you consume in total over the course of that day?

[INTERVIEWER: Record the exact figure. If the respondent is unable to recall precisely, probe for a best estimate.]

_Reply with an exact number (e.g. 0, 1, 3)._

Across the full range of software tools that you have occasion to employ in the course of your professional duties, whether on a routine basis or only intermittently, and including those used for data collection, data management, analysis or reporting, please indicate every one with which you would describe yourself as comfortable working without assistance.

[INTERVIEWER: Read the list aloud. Record all that apply. Do not prompt for tools the respondent does not mention.]

_Reply with all that apply, separated by commas (for example: Stata, R)._

How satisfied are you with the usability and relevance of this instrument, and would you recommend its modality for future data collection exercises?

_Reply in your own words._

In relation to your onward travel arrangements following the conclusion of the training at the end of this week, and taking into consideration any connecting services, transfers or other scheduling constraints that may apply to your itinerary, please indicate the window during which you anticipate departing from Jaipur.

[INTERVIEWER: Record the date and the approximate time. If the respondent is uncertain, probe for the most likely window.]

_Reply with your expected departure date and time._

🧳 Noted: *{{widgets.ARM1_P6.inbound.Body}}*.

Remember to pack your things and be ready in good time for your flight.

properties.body:
🙏 Thank you for completing the survey.

You took part in an experiment with two versions of the same survey: one asking openly in dense prose, and one asking the same things in plain language with tappable answers. You saw one of them.

The second version is the one we recommend, and in the session we will show what your group's answers looked like - and how much the format alone changed them.

See you there.

Thank you for your reply. We understand and respect your decision not to take part in the exercise.

You are still very welcome in the session, where we will look at how WhatsApp data collection works and where it goes wrong.

Thank you for the answers you gave - they are recorded.

We will look at how the format of a question changes the answers it gets, live in the session. See you there.

Understood - I have stopped here and will not send anything else about this survey.

The answers you already gave are kept, and I will not ask you anything more. Thank you for your time.
